description: Rearrange the furniture of a furnished 71 m2 U.S. secondary classroom (Room 114: 24 Virco 785 student desks and 24 9018 stack chairs on glides, a tutoring table with four chairs, a teacher's desk and chair, a book tote, a wastebasket) with a Franka Mobile FR3 Duo (holonomic TMR base, Spine lift, two FR3 arms with Franka Hands). Furniture are free rigid bodies with catalogue masses; glide-floor friction is pair-specific with a static-to-sliding transition; desks tip or slide according to push height and glide type.
count_scope: ten named tasks in preset room114: straighten-row (entry), push-in-chairs (entry), seat-tutoring-group (entry-intermediate), make-pod (intermediate-hard), exam-row (intermediate), chairs-up (hard), chairs-down (hard), clear-floor (intermediate), move-teacher-desk (hard), group-work (hard (extended)); seeds vary the start perturbations; glides (nylon/felt/steel) and contents (0-3 books per involved desk) are physics variations
split_note: Frozen by hash of (task, seed) over seeds 0..999 of every task: {'train': 8016, 'validation': 985, 'test': 999} (classroom_arrangement/variations.json, sha256 a659cd3df40a037c); seeds 1000..9999 resolve with split null.

evaluator.scope: World state only: glides on floor dots, desk yaw, chair tuck depth / in-use distance / facing, pods (edge gap), exam spacing, chairs inverted on their own desk, accessible 0.915 m route on the floor occupancy grid, items upright and at rest over a 1 s window, nothing toppled or in the door swing; group-work matches its identical desks and chairs to the pod places and checks that the rest of the room is as found, and scores 1 on success, else 0.9 x a continuous progress credit x penalties. No autonomous-solution claim. Explicit contract classroom-tasks-v1 adds state-only continuous progress, place matching and rest-of-room preservation for the seven other task_set entries; 1 on success, else 0.9 x progress.

qualification: Component-qualified with assisted evidence: rest, friction, tip/slide, base, spine, grasps, reflex and robot pushes/turns/lifts of furniture by a scripted operator through the robot interface; phantom forces where labelled.
task_set_note: Seven tasks select contract classroom-tasks-v1; group-work keeps its own evaluator. Bare selections and all ten original task IDs remain available. The classroom-tasks-v1 grading is tested on constructed states only and has not yet been run with the simulator.
